purpose: Test whether the three genuine C1 interpolation-accuracy failures can be removed without changing the physical face law, runtime complexity or 262144-byte shared-class memory ceiling.

unchanged_physical_representation.constitutive_family: same unimodal Mualem-van Genuchten KSATFIT law as C1

candidate_representation_change.interpolation_arithmetic: convert four table entries to float64 and evaluate bilinear interpolation in float64
candidate_representation_change.candidate_selection: smallest shared-memory candidate passing all frozen characterization criteria on every stress material

stress_materials.rationale: O01/O05/O14 are the genuine C1 accuracy failures; B01 preserves the qualified Gate B fixture, B12 exercises low-n clay behavior, O13 exercises the catalog minimum n and lambda extreme.

endpoint_policy: Representable boundary values are clamped only after a scale-aware roundoff check against the exact frozen head envelope. The previous C1 endpoint-guard defect is treated as a harness defect and may not be counted as improved physical accuracy.

exit_rule.characterization_pass: freeze the selected N and float32 representation before any new 36-material holdout
exit_rule.characterization_fail: reject this dense-table refinement family fail-closed; do not tune on a future holdout

scope_guard: C1R does not touch KSATEXM, other hydraulic families, saturation switching, heterogeneous profiles, timestep accuracy, processes, bottom boundaries, groundwater, MultiSWAP, real-table response tangents or FullRichards equivalence.
